sloka: जन्मप्रभृति ते वीर सुखदुःखोपसेवनम् ।भविष्यदुत्तरं चेह सर्वं वाल्मीकिना कृतम् ।। ७.९८.१७ ॥
transliteration: janmaprabhṛti te vīra sukhaduḥkhopasevanam ।bhaviṣyaduttaraṁ ceha sarvaṁ vālmīkinā kṛtam ।। 7.98.17 ॥

translations.english: O hero, Valmiki has composed everything, from your birth and the experiences of joy and sorrow, to the future events that will unfold.
